reasoning: The fix corrects a StringBuffer-based version of the "key parsing" loop in NativeND2Reader.parseText, guarding against calling charAt(0) on an empty buffer (equivalent to key.endsWith(":") being falsely true/false on an empty string). Blaming the buggy `while` line traces to commit b48fd4a88c59 which merely refactored the original `String key`/`+=` concatenation into a `StringBuffer` for FindBugs compliance (SBSC_USE_STRINGBUFFER_CONCATENATION) — a pure non-semantic refactor. Tracing further back through renames (bio-formats -> formats-gpl) shows the original `while (!key.endsWith(":") && key.indexOf("_") < 0 && ...)` loop, which lacks any check for an empty/zero-length key string, was first introduced in commit 7b5f4095ea0f87f61540ec01a9c3f8bba6dc1890 ("ND2: parse true Y and Z physical sizes"). This commit added the entire key/value text-block parsing loop that later gets refactored (never fixed for the empty-string edge case) until the 2017 fix commit finally added the `sb.length() == 0` check. This is the true origin of the missing empty-string guard.
